channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Breaking Limits: How 21-Year-Old Self-Taught Kickboxer Shraddha Rangarh Conquered the World Stage and Made History
item.description: With no coach and only YouTube as her guide, Shraddha Rangarh turned sheer determination into history.

item.title: CJI Suryakant Says: Temple Money Belongs to Deity, Can’t Save Struggling Cooperative Banks
item.description: The Supreme Court upheld a directive for banks to repay temple deposits, stressing that sacred offerings must serve only religious interests, not bank survival.

item.title: Nitesh Singh Wins India’s first-ever U21 Taekwondo World Championship Bronze Medal in 2025 Historic Event
item.description: Nitesh Singh and Ankit Mer’s medals mark India’s breakthrough at the first-ever World U21 Taekwondo Championships.

item.title: ‘Total Mess’: ₹21 Lakh Goa Destination Wedding Ruined by IndiGo Mass Flight Cancellations
item.description: A family's dream Goa wedding from crumbled into ₹16.4-21.4 lakh losses after IndiGo's Delhi-Goa flight delays turned to cancellation.

item.title: Mumbai College Revokes Burqa Ban After Student Hunger Strike; Niqab Restriction Stays for Security
item.description: Vivek Vidyalaya Junior College in Mumbai's Goregaon West reversed its burqa ban on 4 December 2025 following a student hunger strike, allowing the attire except niqabs while filing an FIR against six protesters.

item.title: Rajasthan Woman Turns Waste Into Wealth: Sushila Devi Weaves Old Newspapers Into Lakhs-Worth Bags, Uplifting 50 Women
item.description: Sushila Devi in Jhalawar turns personal tragedy and waste papers into a thriving business employing 50 rural women with bags sold up to Rs 2,500 abroad.

item.title: Seema Punia Handed 16-month NADA Doping Ban Third Violation Taints 42-year Discus Career, Asian Games Gold
item.description: Former Asian Games gold medallist Seema Punia receives a 16-month doping suspension from NADA, her third offence from a 2024 test, amid rising concerns in Indian athletics.​

item.title: Dhriti Ranka, Pune Teen With Down Syndrome, Wins National Award for Art and Music Talent
item.description: Dhriti Ranka, 13, with intellectual disabilities, earned the Shrestha Divyang Balika Award for her outstanding art and music achievements.

item.title: Putin–Modi Summit Seals 16 Pacts; Russia Offers Su-57 Jet Localisation as India Targets $100 Billion Trade by 2030
item.description: Russia proposes local Su-57 production as Putin and Modi seal 16 strategic pacts for defence, energy, and $100 billion trade amid global tensions.

item.title: Male Employee Alleges Persistent Harassment by Female Boss in Mumbai, Sparking Debate on POSH Laws
item.description: A viral Reddit post exposes a Mumbai employee's harassment by his female boss, urging reforms for male victims under gender-biased POSH laws.
